question: Who was Prime Minister of India during Eighth five year plan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**P.V. Narsimha Rao**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **Eighth Five-Year Plan of India** was implemented from **1992 to 1997**. This plan marked a shift in economic policy towards liberalization, privatization, and globalization, focusing on sustainable development and economic reforms. 
• **P.V. Narsimha Rao**, the **9th Prime Minister of India**, served from **21 June 1991 to 16 May 1996**. He was the Prime Minister during the majority of the Eighth Five-Year Plan period. 
• Rao’s government is renowned for initiating **economic liberalization reforms**, which opened India's economy to global markets. This was a significant shift from the previous socialist-inspired policies. 
• During the Eighth Five-Year Plan, Rao worked closely with his Finance Minister, **Dr. Manmohan Singh**, to implement **major economic reforms** aimed at reducing fiscal deficits and improving industrial productivity. 
• The plan focused on **modernization of industries**, **export promotion**, **infrastructure development**, and creating employment
